title: Quality, linguists and time tracking
summary: Quality scoring, linguists and feedback, time tracking, feature switches for admins, and a confirm-before-spending dialog.

sections.title: Quality and linguists
sections.note: Score translations, manage your linguists and settle feedback in one place.

items.body: A **Quality** tab on every project
Linguist profiles, and preferred linguists for your work
Feedback threads, ratings and disputes on projects
Set up LQA and QE scoring in **Settings → Quality**
Run QE on a sample, and ignore or reclassify findings

sections.title: Time tracking
sections.note: See where time goes, per person and per project.

items.body: A timesheet for your own time
Team time and project time views
Set it up in **Settings → Time tracking**

sections.title: Control features and spending

items.body: Owners and admins switch modules off in **Settings → Features**
Confirm before a job spends credits
See the QE price before you start
Fairer word counts, with no punctuation surcharge
Hyperlocal: agent videos cost a flat 25 credits

sections.note: Choose which modules your team sees, and approve credit spend before it happens.
